image_description: A black, heavy-duty ring binder standing upright against a white background. The binder features an orange spine and front cover label with the text 'Heavy Duty' and 'wilsonjones'. It has a clear plastic overlay pocket on the front containing a promotional insert image of the ring mechanism. The spine shows a metal hinge mechanism at the top.
